annotation.title_clean: Regulations Amending the Canadian Aviation Regulations (RPAS – Beyond Visual Line-of-Sight and Other Operations): SOR/2025-70
annotation.title_en: Regulations Amending the Canadian Aviation Regulations (RPAS – Beyond Visual Line-of-Sight and Other Operations): SOR/2025-70
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Governor General in Council; Minister of Transport (Transport Canada)
annotation.venue: Canada Gazette, Part II, Vol. 159, No. 7
annotation.summary_en: Canadian regulations (SOR/2025-70) amending the Canadian Aviation Regulations to permit routine lower-risk beyond-visual-line-of-sight drone operations and medium drones (25–150 kg) without special flight certificates. They add pilot certification, manufacturer declarations, operator certificates, registration for all drones 250 g and up, fees and penalties; the Regulatory Impact Analysis Statement is attached.
key_provisions_or_claims: Creates Level 1 Complex Operations pilot certificate (BVLOS) requiring ground school, exams and flight review
Requires RPAS operator certificate with accountable executive, safety processes, training and maintenance control
Manufacturer declarations and pre-validated declarations against Standard 922; service difficulty reporting
Registration extended to all drones of 250 g and above; SFOC required at advertised events
New fees and AMPs; key BVLOS provisions in force November 4, 2025
